meta.title: Signal Harbor: Ideal-State Platform Architecture
meta.subtitle: Three planes: control and knowledge, shared modules, and one isolated data plane per company

boundaries.label: Company data plane: one per company, data sits here only

cards.title: Three planes
items: Control and knowledge plane: the super admin, the module registry, the industry packs and the domain context. It holds no company data
Module plane: the six modules and their agents, the same code for every company
Company data plane: one per company, with its own landing zone, warehouse, intents, context and graph. Company data sits here and nowhere else

cards.title: How a company is created
items: The super admin creates the company, which makes an empty data plane with its own storage and keys
The super admin picks the industry, which decides the pack the agents start from, and switches on the modules that company bought
The company's own users then load their intents, connections and documents; the pack is only ever a suggestion they correct

cards.title: What may cross the company boundary
items: Only structure: which measure links to which process and which kind of source, and how they were joined
Never names, figures, rows, documents or wording that could identify the company
A pattern is kept only when seen in a minimum number of companies, after a person has reviewed it, and only for companies that opted in by contract
The domain context flows back through the industry pack, so every agent starts the next company knowing how it is usually done

cards.title: Repeating it for many companies
items: Every request carries the company; every path, table and graph is resolved inside that company's plane, and a cross-company read fails closed
Modules are stateless: all state lives in the company plane, so adding a company adds storage, not code
The same split as Databricks and Snowflake: a vendor-run control plane and a per-customer data plane, which can later run inside the customer's own cloud

cards.title: The six modules
items: 1 Intent room, 2 Baseline and sensing, 3 Connect, scan and gap, 4 Build, 5 Foresight and advanced modelling, 6 Ops, daily feed and market pulse
One agent per module, Nira across all; every model call goes through one gateway with allowance, guards and evals
Market data enters through the gateway into the module plane; it is never mixed into another company's plane

cards.title: Built today and not yet
items: Built: one workspace per company with isolated storage, super admin, industry packs per domain, sign-in and role gate, model gateway, run registry, two-person push gate
Not built: a module registry that switches modules on per company, the distillation gate, the domain context store
Not built: running a company's data plane inside the customer's own cloud
